content: Twilio Verify delivers OTP via WhatsApp or SMS. WhatsApp requires bringing a sender associated with a WhatsApp Business Account; generic sender assumptions are outdated. Documentation describes automatic WhatsApp-to-SMS optimal selection as a limited pilot, so general fallback availability must not be assumed. Supabase documents integration with Twilio and Twilio Verify. Sources: https://www.twilio.com/docs/verify/whatsapp https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/phone-login . Production delivery and onboarding feasibility remain to be tested for the actual club.
